name: 29349 · Inman, SC
findings: ZIP 29349 (Inman) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29349 (Inman) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29349 (Inman) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
